Name: RevenueRollup
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: RevenueRollup, command: many)
SELECT region, city, upper(city) AS loud_city, coalesce(city, 'all cities') AS city_label,
       grouping(region, city) AS level, sum(amount) AS revenue, count(*) AS sales
FROM sales
GROUP BY ROLLUP (region, city);
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0:region⟩, ⟨c1:city⟩, ⟨c2 aliased:upper(city)⟩ AS loud_city, ⟨c3 aliased:coalesce(city, 'all cities')⟩ AS city_label,
       ⟨c4 aliased:grouping(region, city)⟩ AS level, ⟨c5 aliased:sum(amount)⟩ AS revenue, ⟨c6 aliased:count(*)⟩ AS sales
FROM sales
GROUP BY ROLLUP (region, city);

Name: RegionCityRollup
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: RegionCityRollup, command: many)
SELECT region, city, sum(amount) AS revenue
FROM sales
GROUP BY region, ROLLUP (city);
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:region⟩, ⟨c1:city⟩, ⟨c2 aliased:sum(amount)⟩ AS revenue\nFROM sales\nGROUP BY region, ROLLUP (city);

Name: ProductCube
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: ProductCube, command: many)
SELECT s.region, s.product, count(*) AS sales
FROM sales s
GROUP BY CUBE (s.region, s.product);
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:s.region⟩, ⟨c1:s.product⟩, ⟨c2 aliased:count(*)⟩ AS sales\nFROM sales s\nGROUP BY CUBE (s.region, s.product);

Name: GroupingSets
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: GroupingSets, command: many)
SELECT region, product, date_trunc('month', sold_on) AS month, sum(amount) AS revenue
FROM sales
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((region, product), (date_trunc('month', sold_on)), ());
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:region⟩, ⟨c1:product⟩, ⟨c2 aliased:date_trunc('month', sold_on)⟩ AS month, ⟨c3 aliased:sum(amount)⟩ AS revenue\nFROM sales\nGROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((region, product), (date_trunc('month', sold_on)), ());

Name: PositionalRollup
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: PositionalRollup, command: many)
SELECT lower(region) AS area, sum(amount) AS revenue
FROM sales
GROUP BY ROLLUP (1);
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:lower(region)⟩ AS area, ⟨c1 aliased:sum(amount)⟩ AS revenue\nFROM sales\nGROUP BY ROLLUP (1);

Name: AliasRollup
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: AliasRollup, command: many)
SELECT lower(region) AS area, sum(amount) AS revenue
FROM sales
GROUP BY ROLLUP (area);
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:lower(region)⟩ AS area, ⟨c1 aliased:sum(amount)⟩ AS revenue\nFROM sales\nGROUP BY ROLLUP (area);
